# The Gemini Social

> The Gemini Social is a social media strategy and content business founded by Marina Lira and based on the Sunshine Coast, Queensland, Australia. Marina works with founder-led businesses that value thoughtful content and real connection, with a particular love for wellness and wellbeing brands. Clients are in Australia, New Zealand, the United States and worldwide.

## What I offer

- Instagram and Facebook management for small businesses
- Social media strategy, content planning and content calendars
- Turning a business's own photos and videos into posts and reels, including short-form video editing
- Captions written in the brand's voice and Canva content design
- One tailored Strategic Content Partnership, shaped around each business, with a personalised proposal
- Social media management and local content filming on the Sunshine Coast, depending on the support needed

## How it works

It starts with a free discovery call. Then the client fills in an onboarding form, there is a strategy call, and Marina creates the content calendar and posts. Nothing goes live until the client has approved it.
